method: WCAG sRGB luminance, actual browser computed colors with ancestor alpha compositing; text 4.5:1, control boundaries/focus 3:1. Scoped review, not full application conformance.
scope: Bundled defaults and scoped production-component states; custom overrides and whole-application conformance are not certified. Canvas resolves computed CSS colors to 8-bit sRGB; ratios are not rounded for threshold decisions.
